# World drawing: masks

`cinnabar:world-draw/masks@0.1.0`

Retained union silhouettes. Tokens are private to one component and session.

**Grants:** `entity_highlight`; actor lookup also requires `entity_observe` and `render_through_walls`, elevated coverage requires `render_through_walls`, and effects require `render_post`.

Imported type `handle`: [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle).

Imported type `draw-error`: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error).

<a id="entity"></a>

### `entity`

Resolves an already authorized actor. Unfiltered lookup requires observation authority.

<a id="create"></a>

### `create`

```wit

```

Creates an empty retained mask; its depth policy is fixed at creation.

Types: [`depth-policy`](world-draw-masks.md#type-depth-policy), [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle).

<a id="select"></a>

### `select`

```wit
select: func(mask: handle, entities: list<handle>) -> result<_, draw-error>;
```

Atomically replaces membership; an empty selection clears coverage.

Types: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle).

<a id="remove"></a>

### `remove`

```wit
remove: func(mask: handle) -> result<_, draw-error>;
```

Releases an owned mask once no retained effect references it.

Types: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle).

<a id="set-style"></a>

### `set-style`

```wit
set-style: func(mask: handle, appearance: option<style>) -> result<_, draw-error>;
```

Replaces the host-composed outline and glow; none removes the style without releasing the mask.

Types: [`draw-error`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-draw-error), [`handle`](world-draw-drawing.md#type-handle), [`style`](world-draw-masks.md#type-style).
